source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. 4-star convention: talents named in constellation_talent_boosts are baked at Lv13 (C6 assumed) — skill (C5) and burst (C3) — while the Normal Attack talent, which no constellation boosts, stays Lv10. Normal/charged/plunging are physical (Xiangling has no infusion). constellation2 is C2 'Oil Meets Fire': the Implode explosion, 75% of ATK as AoE Pyro DMG, counted as Normal Attack DMG.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Beware, It's Super Hot!: when Guoba Attack's effects end, Guoba leaves a chili pepper; picking it up increases ATK by 10% for 10s.
C1 Crispy Outside, Tender Inside: opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.
C6 Condensed Pyronado: for the duration of Pyronado, all party members receive a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus.

auto.name: Dough-Fu
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Guoba Attack
skill.desc: Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. Guoba loves to eat spicy food. Problem is, his stomach can't handle something this spicy.

burst.name: Pyronado
burst.desc: Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her. The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. There will never be enough heat. Never.

passives.name: Crossfire
passives.desc: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

passives.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
passives.desc: When <k>Guoba Attack</k>'s effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

passives.name: Chef de Cuisine
passives.desc: When Xiangling cooks an ATK-boosting dish perfectly, she has a 12% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
constellations.desc: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their <e:pyro>Pyro RES</e> reduced by 15% for 6s.

constellations.name: Oil Meets Fire
constellations.desc: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e>.

constellations.name: Deepfry
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Pyronado</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Guoba Mad
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Guoba Attack</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Condensed Pyronado
constellations.desc: For the duration of <k>Pyronado</k>, all party members receive a 15% <e:pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</e>.

auto.name: Cuisine-fu
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups de lance.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour charger en ligne droite et infliger des DGT aux ennemis en chemin.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Attaque Gooba
skill.desc: Xiangling invoque Gooba. Tant que Gooba est actif, il crache du feu sur les ennemis, leur infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone. Gooba raffole des produits épicés... Mais même ça, c'est un peu trop pour lui.

burst.name: Pyrotation
burst.desc: Démontrant à nouveau sa maîtrise du feu et des armes, Xiangling libère une tornade de feu qui tournoie autour d'elle. La tornade suit le personnage tant qu'elle est active, infligeant des DGT Pyro aux ennemis sur sa route. On n'a jamais assez d'explosif. JAMAIS.

passives.name: Feux croisés
passives.desc: Augmente la portée des crachats de feu de Gooba de 20 %.

passives.name: Attention, ça pique
passives.desc: À la fin d'<k>Attaque Gooba</k>, le gentil petit Gooba laisse un piment à son emplacement avant de disparaître. Ce piment confère un bonus de 10 % d'ATQ pendant 10 s à celui qui le ramasse.

passives.name: Cheffe cuisinière
passives.desc: 12 % de chances d'obtenir un plat supplémentaire lorsque vous cuisinez un plat parfait qui renforce l'ATQ.

constellations.name: Croustillant à l'extérieur, tendre à l'intérieur
constellations.desc: La <e:pyro>RÉS Pyro</e> des ennemis touchés par Gooba diminue de 15 % pendant 6 s.

constellations.name: L'huile sur le feu
constellations.desc: Le dernier coup d'attaque normale inflige pendant 2 s un effet d'implosion aux ennemis. Au bout de ce délai, ils explosent, infligeant des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> équivalant à 75 % de l'ATQ.

constellations.name: Pyrotation condensée
constellations.desc: Les <e:pyro>DGT Pyro</e> de tous les personnages de l'équipe augmentent de 15 % tant que <k>Pyrotation</k> est active.
